blurb: Guests can visit the open-air tasting room in Green Valley of the Russian River Valley to sip wines from estate vineyards with sweeping views of Sonoma County. The winery produces sustainably farmed, estate-bottled still and sparkling wines specific to the Green Valley of the Russian River Valley AVA. They offer wine club memberships with perks including exclusive wines, complimentary tastings, and special pricing.
